name: SGLang Chunked PP: DeepSeek-V3.1 prefill throughput 3.31x with PP4 TP8 vs TP8 on H20
unit: x speedup (prefill throughput ratio, PP4 TP8 vs TP8, batch size 1)
methodology: Hardware: H20 cluster (4 nodes, 32 GPUs total). Engine: SGLang with Chunked Pipeline Parallelism (CPP), async P2P communication, dynamic chunking. Model: DeepSeek-V3.1. Workload: batch size 1, ultra-long context prefill. Configuration: PP4 TP8 (4 pipeline stages, 8 tensor parallel per stage) with chunked prefill size 12288 (12K) and dynamic chunking smooth factor 0.65. Comparison: PP4 TP8 yields 3.31x prefill throughput vs TP8 alone, and outperforms TP32 by 30.5%. Also reports up to 67.9% TTFT reduction with 82.8% strong scaling efficiency. For Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 on H20 with PP8: up to 81% TTFT reduction for ultra-long prompts.
notes: Published by LMSYS on 2026-01-15. Demonstrates that pipeline parallelism with chunked prefill is the most effective strategy for long-context prefill at scale. The 3.31x throughput gain from PP4 TP8 vs TP8 shows that TP alone hits communication bottlenecks (all-reduce after every layer), while PP reduces communication volume by only transferring at pipeline boundaries. Dynamic chunking eliminates pipeline bubbles from fixed scheduling. Compatible with PD disaggregation and HiCache.
